What Are Weight Loss Injections?

A Safe, Doctor-Guided Way to Lose Weight Without Surgery
Weight loss injections are a type of prescription-based medication that help regulate appetite and improve metabolism.

They mimic natural hormones in your body to reduce hunger, increase satiety, and promote fat loss.

When used under expert medical supervision, they are a safe and effective way to manage obesity and weight-related health issues.

How Do Weight Loss Injections Work?

Science-Backed Injections That Help Regulate Appetite and Blood Sugar
Weight loss injections work by mimicking a natural hormone in your body called GLP-1 (Glucagon-Like Peptide-1), which is responsible for regulating hunger and blood sugar.

When injected, this medication slows down your digestion, helps control blood sugar spikes, and sends signals to your brain that make you feel full faster and for longer.

Because of this, you naturally eat less without feeling starved or deprived. Over time, this reduced calorie intake leads to sustainable weight loss.

Many patients notice a significant drop in appetite within the first few weeks, followed by steady weight reduction over the next few months.

FAQs About Weight Loss Treatment

Get answers to your most common questions

Are weight loss injections safe?

Yes, they are approved by global and Indian regulatory authorities and are prescribed by qualified doctors only after evaluating your medical history. When taken under medical supervision, they are considered safe for eligible individuals.

How much weight can I expect to lose?

Patients typically lose 5% to 15% of their body weight over a 3 to 6-month period, depending on consistency, lifestyle changes, and overall health status. Individual results may vary.

How long should I continue these injections?

Doctor usually recommend continuing for at least 3 to 6 months for noticeable results. Some may require longer treatment depending on weight loss goals and medical condition. Your doctor will decide the duration during your consultation.

Will I regain weight after stopping the injections?

Weight maintenance depends on your diet, activity level, and habits after stopping the injection. That’s why we offer holistic care—including lifestyle guidance and diet plans—to ensure long-term success.

Do I need to follow a diet while taking the injection?

Yes. While the injection helps suppress appetite, combining it with a healthy diet and active lifestyle improves results significantly. Our experts will guide you with a personalized food and fitness plan.

What are the causes Ear Lobe?

Common everyday habits and factors that can weaken, stretch, or tear your earlobes over time.

Heavy Earrings

Wearing heavy earrings for long periods can stretch and weaken the earlobe. Over time, this can lead to elongated holes or complete tearing.

Multiple Piercings

Too many piercings or improper placement can weaken the earlobe tissue. This increases the risk of splitting or deformation.

Accidental Pulling

Earrings can get caught in clothing, hair, or objects. This sudden pull may cause partial or complete earlobe tears.

Aging

As skin loses elasticity with age, earlobes may sag or stretch. This can make piercing holes appear larger over time.

Gauging (Stretching)

Intentional stretching for large earrings can permanently alter the earlobe shape. It often requires surgical correction to restore normal appearance.

Infections or Trauma

Infections, injuries, or improper aftercare can damage the earlobe tissue. This may lead to scarring, tearing, or irregular shape.

Unlike dermal fillers which add volume, skin boosters hydrate and improve skin texture from the inside out. They work by deeply moisturizing the skin, stimulating collagen production, and restoring elasticity.

Think of them as long-lasting internal moisturizers — perfect for dry, aging, sun-damaged, or fatigued skin.
A revolutionary solution for dull, tired, or dehydrated skin.

  • Have uneven texture or rough skin:

  • Suffer from post-acne scars or pitted skin:
    Improves skin structure by boosting collagen and healing the skin barrier.

    Ideal for those who want results without downtime or drastic changes.

Our dermatologist evaluates your skin condition and recommends the right type of booster.

Area is cleansed and a topical numbing cream is applied to reduce discomfort.

Science-backed skin regeneration using the purest source of DNA – salmon sperm.

✅ Promotes angiogenesis and skin cell turnover

A revolutionary laser treatment for skin rejuvenation and scar reduction.
Fractional CO2 Laser Skin Resurfacing is a cutting-edge, non-surgical treatment designed to improve skin texture, tone, and elasticity.

    Frequently Asked Questions About Dermatology Care

    Your skin and hair deserve the best care.

    What conditions do dermatologists treat?

    Dermatologists treat a wide range of skin, hair, and nail conditions including acne, eczema, psoriasis, rosacea, hair loss, pigmentation disorders, and skin infections. They also provide cosmetic services like anti-aging treatments, skin rejuvenation, and hair restoration.

    When should I see a dermatologist?

    If you’re experiencing persistent skin issues like acne, unusual rashes, severe hair loss, or changes in your skin that don’t resolve with over-the-counter treatments, it’s time to consult a dermatologist for a professional evaluation.

    What should I expect during my first dermatologist visit?

    During your first visit, the dermatologist will review your medical history, discuss your skin concerns, and perform a skin examination. They may recommend treatments or further tests to diagnose your condition and create a personalized care plan.

    Are cosmetic treatment safe?

    Yes, when performed by a qualified dermatologist, cosmetic treatments such as Botox, dermal fillers, and laser therapy are safe and effective. Dr Sandeep Mahapatra, our dermatologists prioritizes patient safety and ensure all procedures are done following the highest medical standards.

    Do dermatologists treat hair and scalp problems?

    Yes, dermatologists are trained to diagnose and treat a variety of hair and scalp conditions including dandruff, hair thinning, alopecia, and other scalp disorders.

    What is the cost of a consultation with a dermatologist?

    Consultation fees vary depending on the clinic and the services required. It’s best to contact us directly for detailed pricing information and any package options available.

    How often should I visit a dermatologist?

    It’s recommended to visit a dermatologist at least once a year for a routine skin check. However, if you have specific skin concerns or are undergoing treatment, more frequent visits may be necessary.

    Can I get same-day appointments for urgent skin conditions?

    We strive to accommodate urgent cases as quickly as possible. Contact our clinic for availability and we’ll do our best to schedule a same-day appointment for pressing skin concerns.

What is Hair Transplant?

"A permanent solution for hair loss and thinning.
Hair transplant is a surgical procedure that moves hair follicles from a donor area (usually the back or sides of the scalp) to areas experiencing hair thinning or baldness.

At Derma Solutions, we specialize in the Neo Follicle Transplant (NFT) method, an advanced version of FUE (Follicular Unit Extraction), ensuring natural-looking and long-lasting results.

Enhances facial hair density for a fuller look.

Neo Follicle Transplant (NFT): The Advanced Hair Transplant Technique

Revolutionizing hair restoration with precision and effectiveness.

NFT is a state-of-the-art hair transplant method derived from FUE but optimized for better follicle survival and natural results. This technique focuses on careful extraction and implantation of individual hair follicles, ensuring minimal trauma to the scalp and a quicker recovery.

Benefits of NFT:

  • Enhanced Follicle Survival Rate: Increases graft success.
  • Minimal Downtime: Faster recovery with less discomfort.
  • Natural Hairline: Precisely designed for a seamless appearance.

What to Expect During Your Hair Transplant Procedure

A step-by-step guide to your NFT hair transplant journey.

Step 1: Consultation and Assessment

Scalp analysis and discussion of goals with our hair transplant specialists.

Step 2: Planning and Preparation

Custom design of the hairline and donor area evaluation.

Step 3: NFT Extraction

Individual follicular units are extracted with precision to ensure survival. The hair follicular units are extracted one by one from the donor area by using the most advanced semi-automated instruments with a diameter of 0.7mm to 0.8mm.

Step 4: Preparation of Scalp

The scalp is first prepared first by infusing GFT (Growth Factor Therapy) before implanting the follicles. The growth factor present in the semipermeable membrane will act as a booster to the transplanted hair follicles.

The extracted hair follicle are segregated and preserved in a liquid solution under a specific temperature which enhances the growth after the implantation.

Step 5: Graft Implantation

The hair follicle are implanted directly using NFT implanter by the hair transplant surgeon. This implanter will enable the surgeon to have complete control on the angle, depth and direction of the follicle to gain complete natural results with maximum density.

Hair follicles are carefully implanted to create a natural hairline and density.

Step 6: Post-Treatment Care

Detailed aftercare instructions for optimal recovery and results.

Weight Loss Treatment In Marathahalli

Weight loss in the context of medicine or health refers to the reduction of the accumulated fat, fluids, bone mineral deposits, muscle and other connective tissue, that put together increases the body mass.

Weight loss occurs due to malnutrition as well or because of an already present disease or from a conscious effort to improve an actual overweight or obese state. The weight loss that’s not caused by reduction in caloric intake or exercise is termed as “Cachexia”. Whereas on the flip side intentional weight loss is commonly referred to as “Slimming”.

Before starting any Weight Loss Treatment a diagnosis is done to understand the body condition of the person.

General diagnosis includes:

  • Looking at your health history
  • Physical Examination
  • BMI Calculation
  • Waist circumference measurement
  • Checking if there is any other health problem
  • Blood test

The weight-loss treatment is mainly concerned with reaching a state of healthy weight. This helps in the reduction of complications relating to obesity. Weight loss treatment is performed by a team of health professionals including a dietitian, behavioural counselor who is also called as an “Obesity specialist”.

During the initial stage the main goal is to reduce the body mass by 5% to 10%, for example is a person is weighing 220.5 pounds (100 kg), then we would focus to loss the weight about 10 to 20 pounds that is nearly 4.5 to 9 kg. The methodology of treatment will change if the client wishes to lose more weight.

The process of weight loss will be more beneficial when the client has a strict control over his/her diet. Hence, after the treatment there will be a dietitian who will prescribe what is to be taken by the clients. The benefits of weight reduction treatment can only be seen when the clients follow the strict diet which is prescribed by the dietitian.

Diet Changes will include:

  • Reduction in intake of calories.
  • Having a healthier food choice.
  • Restricting certain food which contains more gluten.
  • Changing the Meal pattern.



Weight loss medication:

The doctor may recommend a weight loss medication only when exercise and diet control does not work and also by satisfying any one of the below mentioned criteria.

  • When BMI of an individual is greater than 30.
  • When BMI is more than 27 and there is a presence of other medical complications like obesity, diabetes, high blood pressure etc.

Before prescribing any medication, the doctor will first go through your past medical history to check that the prescribed medicine will not cause any side effects. If the medication is stopped abruptly then the lost weight will be regained.

Medication approved by FDA:

  • Orlistat(Alli, xenical)
  • Lorcaserin(Belviq)
  • Phentermine & Topiramate(Qsymia)
  • Bupropion and Naltrexone(Contrave)
  • Liraglutide(Saxenda, victoza)

Weight loss is also possible through exercise and physical activity. People who are more conscious about maintaining their weight will exercise on a regular basis. This can be maintained by simple walking or even jogging.

Behaviour changes do contribute to weight loss that is a change in lifestyle will help you in identifying the present habits to find out what factors contribute to obesity. On the flip side, there are other methodologies that are used to reduce weight like “Endoscopic Procedure” or weight loss surgery like “Gastric Bypass Surgery, Adjustable Gastric Banding, Biliopancreatic Diversion with Duodenal Switch, Gastric Sleeve”.

Understanding the Cost for Weight Loss Treatment: Cryolipolysis

Cost for Weight Loss Treatment using cryolipolysis, commonly known as fat freezing, typically ranges from ₹15,000 to ₹30,000 per session. This price can vary based on factors such as the size of the area being treated, the clinic’s location, and the expertise of the professionals administering the procedure.
Cryolipolysis is a non-invasive method that targets fat cells in areas like the abdomen, thighs, and arms by cooling them to a temperature that naturally breaks them down, providing a non-surgical option for fat reduction.

It’s also important to consider that an additional 18% GST is applicable to the total cost of the procedure.
This comprehensive approach allows clients to achieve noticeable results with minimal recovery time, making it a popular choice for effective weight loss treatment.

Inch Reduction Treatment In Bangalore

Inch reduction is a process of weight loss whereby the weight reduction is more focused on losing weight or inches from a specific part of the body where he/she has accumulated fat. Every individual wish to maintain his/her body shape in a good condition.

This treatment is non-surgical.
There is no side effects and no heavy exercise that is required to be done.

The excess fat from the specific area is treated with the use of high-end technology, whereby the fat is targeted and expelled.
The techniques used for inch reduction is “Ultrasonic Lipolysis” and “Radio frequency Skin Tightening”.

Ultrasonic Lipolysis

It is a non-surgical treatment to get rid of fat. Ultrasound waves are used to expel the excess accumulated fat.
Then a transducer is placed on the affected area where it emits energy.

These fat cells are metabolised by the body and are drained out, that helps in weight loss.

Radio Frequency Skin Tightening

This technique induces tissues remodelling and production of new collagen and elastin.
This process is an alternative to facelift and other cosmetic surgeries.

Radio Frequency is used for heating and reducing the fat. In the current period, most radiofrequency devices are to noninvasively manage and treat skin tightening as well as reduce wrinkles and fat reduction.

Cost for Inch Reduction Treatment

such as Cryolipolysis, generally falls between ₹15,000 to ₹30,000 per session.
This inch-loss procedure is a popular non-surgical option that works by freezing and eliminating stubborn fat cells, particularly in targeted areas like the abdomen, thighs, and arms.

The price range for this treatment can vary based on factors like the size of the area being treated, the clinic’s location, and the experience level of the professionals handling the procedure.

Phototherapy, also known as light therapy, is a non-invasive medical procedure that uses specific wavelengths of ultraviolet (UV) light to treat various skin conditions.

How Does Phototherapy Treatment Work?

The science behind effective light-based therapy.

Phototherapy uses controlled exposure to specific wavelengths of ultraviolet (UV) light—either UVA or UVB.

These light waves penetrate the skin’s surface, targeting affected areas without damaging surrounding tissues. By modulating the immune response and reducing inflammation, phototherapy promotes skin healing and regeneration.

NARROW BAND ULTRAVIOLET B (NB-UVB) PHOTOTHERAPY uses 290-320 nm wavelength, which is the best type of phototherapy treatment for vitiligo.

These units can be used for very small localized areas of white vitiliginous patches like lips, fingertips, hands and feet to whole-body generalised vitiligo by using whole body chambers.

At Derma Solutions, we have whole body NB UVB PHOTOTHERAPY chamber to treat whole body vitiligo, Psoriasis etc. .

The unit is equipped with NBUVB lamps micro computerised electronic controller with LCD display. Optimum dose for each indication corresponds to 0.7-0.9 MED (minimal erythema dose) and depending upon skin type dose of irradiation is adjusted by the doctor and overall time for each treatment. Approx 3-4 minutes for each area is advised and incremental dosing is done every session depending upon patients feedback.

Treatment is done twice or thrice weekly. Patient should wear protective eye goggles and apply sunscreens on untreated areas of face and neck. Side-effects might be redness, itching and peeling of skin, eye irritation, headache, phototoxic erythema etc.

It is one of the safest form of medical treatment for generalised and even unstable VITILIGO, and promises desired results. The cost of phototherapy in Bangalore varies depending on the condition you want to treat, but it is generally affordable.

At Derma Solutions, we have successfully treated thousands of patients of Vitiligo, Psoriasis, Lichen Planus and Mycosis Fungoides by the latest NB-UVB whole body phototherapy chambers and hand held phototherapy units.

What is Vitiligo?

Understanding the skin condition and its impact on your life.
Vitiligo is a skin condition characterized by the loss of pigmentation, resulting in white patches on the skin.

It occurs when the melanocytes, the cells responsible for producing pigment, stop functioning or die.

While the exact cause is unknown, it is believed to be an autoimmune disorder and can affect individuals of any age, gender, or skin type.

Key Features of Vitiligo:

  • Affects any area of the body, including the face, hands, and extremities.
  • Can progress over time if left untreated.
  • Not contagious but may have a genetic component.

What Causes Vitiligo?

Identifying the triggers behind this skin condition.

Autoimmune Response

The immune system attacks the melanocytes, leading to pigment loss.

Genetics

A family history of vitiligo increases the risk.

Environmental Factors

Sunburn, chemical exposure, or stress can act as triggers.

Oxidative Stress

Imbalance of free radicals and antioxidants in the skin.
Types of Vitiligo:

• Segmental Vitiligo: Localized patches on one side of the body.
• Non-Segmental Vitiligo: Symmetrical patches on both sides of the body.
• Focal Vitiligo: Limited to a few small areas.
• Mucosal Vitiligo: Affects areas like lips and inside the mouth.

Recognizing the signs for early intervention.

  • Loss of pigment in the mucous membranes, such as the mouth or nose.

Cosmetic surgery focuses on enhancing appearance, while plastic surgery involves reconstructive procedures to repair or restore functionality due to injury, disease, or congenital issues.

Is cosmetic plastic surgery safe?
Yes, the risks are minimal when performed by experienced surgeons in a certified clinic like Derma Solutions. Always ensure your procedure is conducted by a licensed professional.

What is the recovery time for these procedures?
Recovery varies depending on the procedure. For example, liposuction may take 1-2 weeks, while abdominoplasty could require up to 6 weeks for full recovery.

How do I choose the best cosmetic surgery clinic?
Look for clinics with experienced surgeons, positive reviews, and a wide range of services. Derma Solutions is renowned for its expertise and patient-centric care.

Are the results of cosmetic surgery permanent?
While most procedures provide long-lasting results, factors like aging, lifestyle, and weight changes may affect the outcome. Regular follow-ups help maintain results.

Depth of Treatment: Traditional Microneedling primarily targets the upper layers of the skin, while MNRF delivers RF energy to the deeper layers, resulting in more extensive skin rejuvenation. 2. Treatment Targets: Microneedling is ideal for improving skin texture and reducing scarring, while MNRF achieves these benefits and provides effective skin tightening and lifting. 3. Downtime: Both procedures have minimal downtime, but MNRF might involve slightly more redness and swelling due to the additional RF energy delivery. 4. Suitability: Traditional Microneedling is generally suitable for a wide range of skin types, while MNRF may be more beneficial for individuals seeking significant skin tightening and anti-aging effects.

Chemical Peels

PRP Therapy (Platelet-Rich Plasma)

PRP uses your body’s own platelets to accelerate the skin’s repair process. It can be combined with treatments like laser to boost results and promote faster healing.

What Causes Warts?

Warts are caused by certain strains of the human papillomavirus (HPV), which infects the top layer of skin.

The virus enters through small cuts or abrasions, leading to abnormal growth of skin cells.

They spread via contact with infected source and also sexually sometimes in genital area. Warts are very recurrent in nature.

Warts are more common in individuals with weakened immune systems or those frequently exposed to moist environments.

Type of Warts

  • Common Warts : Appear on hands and fingers; rough and dome-shaped.
  • Plantar Warts : Found on the soles of the feet; often painful due to pressure.
  • Flat Warts : Smaller, smoother warts that commonly appear on the face, arms, or legs.
  • Filiform Warts : Long, thread-like warts usually found on the face
  • Genital Warts : Appear in the genital area and require specialized treatment.

Frequently Asked Questions About Laser Hair Removal

Get answers to the most common concerns.

What is laser hair removal?

Laser hair removal is a medical procedure that uses concentrated light to target and destroy hair follicles, resulting in long-term hair reduction.

Is laser hair removal permanent?

It offers long-term hair reduction, but some maintenance treatments may be necessary over time.

How many sessions are needed?

Typically, 6-8 sessions are required for optimal results, but this can vary based on hair type and area treated.

Is laser hair removal painful?

Most people experience mild discomfort, often described as a snapping sensation. Numbing creams can be used to enhance comfort.

Are there any side effects?

Common side effects include temporary redness, swelling, and mild irritation, which usually subside within a few hours.

Who is a good candidate for laser hair removal?

It works best on individuals with light skin and dark hair, but advancements in technology have made it effective for a wider range of skin and hair types.

How much does laser hair removal cost?

The cost varies depending on the area treated and the number of sessions required. It’s best to consult with a clinic for specific pricing.

Can I resume normal activities after the treatment?

Yes, but it’s advisable to avoid direct sun exposure and strenuous exercise for a day or two following the treatment.

Understanding the Science of Laser Hair Removal

How advanced laser technology targets hair follicles for long-lasting results.
01.

Emission of Laser Energy

The laser device emits a concentrated beam of light energy that penetrates the skin and targets the melanin (pigment) in the hair shaft.

02.

Heat Absorption

The pigment absorbs the light energy, which transforms into heat. This heat damages the hair follicle at its root, inhibiting future hair growth.

03.

Precision Targeting

The laser precisely targets the hair follicle without affecting the surrounding skin, making the process safe and effective for most skin types.

04.

Hair Growth Cycle Consideration

Since hair grows in cycles, multiple sessions are needed to target all active (anagen) hair follicles effectively.

05.

Gradual Hair Reduction

With each session, hair growth becomes finer and sparser until the treated area is smooth and hair-free.
